limitations: Synthetic-only matrix, no real-project small/medium/dense corpus proof
Sequential throughput only; concurrent throughput matrix pending
Queue/codec/roundtrip split and XRW2 IPC/stderr total counters unavailable
Binary hashes are measured declarations tied to successful CI build/run provenance, not independently checked executable bytes: uploaded artifacts omit binaries
CPU session totals include source loading, warmup, validation, retained-ticket calibration and shutdown; request latencies begin after Request construction
Sampled RSS is simultaneous sum, shared pages can be double-counted and short-lived workers/between-sample peaks can be missed
Retained ticket delay shows positive reserve then release; completion timestamp before reading reserve is not observed
80ms idle delay is declared but RSS idle baseline has no synchronized phase marker
First-for-process/warmup flags do not establish OS page-cache cold or per-grammar cache phase
macOS15.7.9 result does not prove literal macOS15.0 or disposable arbitrary-shell containment
review_mode: offline verification only; no measured replay, compilation or new benchmark run
